title: Answer Refunds and Disputes Against Your Policy
summary: Apply your written refund and dispute policy to each case, with drafts that wait for your approval and a weekly view of the rates.

money_potential.label: Medium
money_potential.basis: Assumes you handle refunds and disputes yourself; the value is consistent replies that you approve.
money_potential.note: Value tiers are our rough estimates (labeled Estimate) of relative value to the business, each with its assumption. They are not promises, income claims or advice. Results depend on your market, offer and effort.

how_it_makes_money: Consistent answers to buyers, so fewer cases escalate.
Dispute evidence is ready before the deadline, not after.

stack.name: Customer Care
stack.role: Applies your written policy, drafts dispute responses and prepares refund drafts for approval.
stack.creator: ColinMcDermott

stack.name: Refund Resolution Desk
stack.role: Works through open refund cases and keeps each one on track.
stack.creator: Community submission

inputs.label: Your written policy and each case

steps.name: Customer Care
steps.does: Drafts dispute replies and refund drafts

steps: Write your refund and dispute policy in plain words.
Run a few past cases and compare with your own decisions.
Approve or edit each draft before it reaches a buyer.
Review the weekly refund and dispute rates.
guardrails: Nothing reaches a buyer without your approval.
Keep delivery records, since disputes depend on them.
